strings.zh: 真羡慕你们这些离开镇子,{NEWLINE}到外面旅行的训练家啊！{SCROLL}我经常偷跑出镇子跟精灵玩,{NEWLINE}偶尔也会去草丛中捡点果实。{SCROLL}如果捡到好东西的话,{NEWLINE}我会分你一点的{SCROLL}相信会对你的旅行有帮助,{NEWLINE}所以把你电话号码告诉我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I really envy you Trainers who{NEWLINE}get to leave town and travel!{SCROLL}I often sneak out of town to play{NEWLINE}with my Pokémon, and sometimes I{CLEAR}pick Berries in the grass.{SCROLL}If I find anything good,{NEWLINE}I’ll share some with you.{SCROLL}I’m sure it’ll help you on your{NEWLINE}journey, so give me your phone number!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 有了发现后我会打电话给你的,{NEWLINE}期待我能找到什么好东西吧！
strings.en: I’ll call you when I find{NEWLINE}something. Look forward to it!

strings.zh: 是吗,好遗憾啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}还想着能通过电话,{NEWLINE}多了解点旅行途中的故事呢！
strings.en: Oh, what a shame...{SCROLL}I was hoping you’d tell me stories{NEWLINE}from your journey over the phone!

strings.zh: 我进入草丛后,{NEWLINE}偶尔能找到果实⋯⋯{SCROLL}我会分给你一点的,{NEWLINE}所以把你电话号码给我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: When I go into the grass, I sometimes{NEWLINE}find Berries...{SCROLL}I’ll share some with you, so give me{NEWLINE}your phone number! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0684/4 | RV072: meaning: 偶尔 = sometimes; removed 'all kinds'

strings.zh: 你来了啊！{NEWLINE}就是这些⋯⋯{CLEAR}送给你吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Good to see you!{NEWLINE}See? This is what I found.{CLEAR}It’s for you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你就在附近吧？{NEWLINE}那就干脆来找我好了！
strings.en: You’re nearby aren’t you? Well, then{NEWLINE}just come talk in person!

strings.zh: 你的精灵们在成长吗？{SCROLL}我的精灵{NEWLINE}现在正在飞速成长！{SCROLL}其中{VAR:0100:10}是{NEWLINE}成长得最快的,{CLEAR}已经变得非常强了！{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: Are your Pokémon growing?{SCROLL}Mine are growing really fast!{SCROLL}{VAR:0100:10} is growing fastest of{NEWLINE}all. It’s already really strong!{SCROLL}Bye!

strings.zh: 前几天我仅一招就把{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}给打倒了⋯⋯{SCROLL}看它这么不堪一击,{NEWLINE}感觉怪可怜的⋯⋯{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: Oh yeah, we knocked out a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} with one hit a while back.{SCROLL}It went down so easily, I felt a{NEWLINE}little sorry for the poor thing.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 前几天在最后关头{NEWLINE}还是被{VAR:0100:11}给逃跑了⋯⋯{SCROLL}虽然那是个常见的精灵,{SCROLL}但在你想抓它的时候{NEWLINE}逃走了,还是很不甘心啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}再见啦！
strings.en: Oh yeah, a wild {VAR:0100:11} got{NEWLINE}away from me at the last second.{SCROLL}I know it’s a common Pokémon...{SCROLL}But it does annoy me that it got{NEWLINE}away when I almost had it.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 来一场对战吧？{NEWLINE}我不会再输给你了！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你,{NEWLINE}来了就找我吧！
strings.en: Do you feel like a Pokémon battle?{NEWLINE}It won’t be like last time!{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}’s where I’ll be.{NEWLINE}Let me know when you get there.

strings.notes: US 0684/11 | seed rejected us [tag_mismatch] (candidate US 0684#11; text not kept); zh {VAR:0103:3} where US has the location buffer; kept as in zh

strings.zh: 什么？果实？{SCROLL}抱歉我还没有找到。{NEWLINE}等我找到了的话{CLEAR}我会打给你电话的,别急！
strings.en: Huh? Berries?{SCROLL}Sorry, I haven’t found any yet.{NEWLINE}I’ll call you if I find any.{CLEAR}Will you please wait?

strings.zh: 喂,看来我找到{NEWLINE}一些果实了,{CLEAR}你要吗？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}。
strings.en: Hey, looks like I found{NEWLINE}some Berries. Want some?{SCROLL}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}.
How come you’re not here yet?{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3} is where I am.{NEWLINE}Please get here as soon as you can!

strings.zh: 城都的自然公园{NEWLINE}有举办捕虫大会的吧？{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}会去吗？{SCROLL}我⋯⋯恐怕不能离开镇子。
strings.en: They hold the Bug-Catching Contest{NEWLINE}at the National Park in Johto,{CLEAR}right? Are you going, {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}I... probably can’t leave town.

strings.zh: 城都的自然公园{NEWLINE}有举办捕虫大会的吧？{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}会去吗？{SCROLL}我⋯⋯家里应该不同意我去吧。
strings.en: They hold the Bug-Catching Contest{NEWLINE}at the National Park in Johto,{CLEAR}right? Are you going, {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}My... my family probably{NEWLINE}won’t let me go.
